result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mostly related to clipped/obscured content and a potentially missing icon in the header.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is partially covered by the fixed bottom navigation bar. The pizza image continues underneath the nav, making the content feel cut off and harder to interact with.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area inset to the scrollable content so the last visible cards are not hidden behind the bottom tab bar.

issues.description: The circular control in the top-right header appears empty except for a small red dot. It looks like an icon, avatar, or notification graphic may be missing.
issues.suggestion: Add the intended icon/avatar inside the circle, or remove the circle if only the notification dot is needed.

issues.description: A partially visible empty category pill appears at the far right of the category row after “Healthy,” which looks like a clipped or blank filter chip.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the next category chip has visible text/icon when partially shown, or add spacing/fade treatment so the horizontal scroll preview looks intentional.

issues.description: Items in the “Fastest near you” carousel are heavily clipped on the right edge, including the third restaurant card and its text. While horizontal scrolling may be intended, the cut-off content looks abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding, a fade edge, or adjust card widths so clipped carousel items appear intentionally scrollable.
